definition: below average in number or quantity
description: An elegant restaurant with dark panelled walls, a crystal chandelier and green velvet chairs. A man with his hair tied back, a brown suit and an open white shirt sits at a round table with a knife and fork. On his huge white plate lies only one tiny piece of fish with a sprig of herbs. A waitress in black adds a garnish with long silver tweezers and steps away. The man looks up with a raised eyebrow, then cuts the piece and lifts the whole thing on his fork, leaving the plate empty.

taps.phrase: to look up at the waitress
